ticker_news.title: Here Is Your $25,000 EV; It Will Cost You $36,990!
ticker_news.description: Tesla continues to demonstrate an overly optimistic approach to product delivery and feature implementation, yet investors remain supportive as long as stock performance remains strong.
ticker_news.author: Parkev Tatevosian, Cfa

ticker_news.title: Peter Thiel Reportedly Warned Elon Musk To Rethink Donating His Wealth: 'Much Worse To Give It To Bill Gates'
ticker_news.description: Peter Thiel cautioned Elon Musk about donating wealth through the Giving Pledge, expressing concerns about potential recipients like Bill Gates and warning about the risk of funding 'left-wing non-profits'.
ticker_news.author: Namrata Sen
